record.one_liner: Shopify is an ecommerce platform offering extensive APIs (primarily GraphQL Admin and Storefront APIs), developer tools like Shopify CLI, and OAuth-based authentication for building integrated apps.

auth_methods.quote: Shopify supports three, and which one applies depends on where your app runs and whose stores it acts on: Token exchange... Authorization code grant... Client credentials grant... A short-lived JWT that proves a request comes from an authenticated Shopify user.

access_test.quote: Dev stores are stores with test data that you build and test against.

access_ship.quote: Publish your app in the Shopify App Store and any merchant can install it once it passes review.

api_type.quote: Shopify apps call the GraphQL Admin API to read and write store data on behalf of merchants.

api_breadth.quote: GraphQL Admin API reads and writes products, customers, orders, inventory, and the rest of the data behind the Shopify admin.

official_mcp.quote: Shopify MCP lets merchants and partners set up and manage a store through the AI agent of their choice.
